Source: Fight Matrix, https://www.fightmatrix.com/
Terms reviewed: 2026-10-08; see LICENSE.txt.

html/ is a local cache of twelve current-ranking pages and one all-time page,
obtained by loaders/fightmatrix_loader.py. These are complete third-party HTML
pages, including layout and comments, rather than only extracted ranking facts.
Cached current pages state issue date 2026-05-10, official release 1023; the
all-time page states update date 2026-08-02. These are source issue dates.
The loader does not record exact retrieval timestamps.

The source pages' canonical URLs are:
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/heavyweight-265-lbs/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/light-heavyweight-185-205-lbs/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/middleweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/welterweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/lightweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/featherweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/bantamweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/flyweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/womens-pound-for-pound/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/womens-bantamweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/womens-flyweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/mma-ranks/womens-strawweight/
https://www.fightmatrix.com/all-time-mma-rankings/all-time-absolute/

The bounded profile loader, loaders/fightmatrix_profiles.py, also extracts
biographical fields and factual bout records from linked fighter profiles.
These outputs differ from the raw ranking-page cache; neither extraction nor
attribution establishes a redistribution grant. The source FAQ identifies
Sherdog as its main bout source: https://www.fightmatrix.com/faq/

organization_normalization.csv contains this project's authored promotion rules;
it is not a downloaded Fight Matrix table.

No redistribution licence or permission record was identified for source HTML
or extracted source compilations. See LICENSE.txt before distributing either.
